This notebook builds a **merged binary dataset** from multiple GEO studies and compares multiple class-weighting schemes using leakage-safe leave-one-dataset-out evaluation.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(class)
library(e1071)

library(sva)
library(glmnet)       # ElasticNet / Lasso (binary + multinomial)
# XGBoost loaded conditionally below
```

## Dataset registry + merge helpers

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
datasets_multiclass <- c("GSE25066","GSE45827")          # PAM50 multiclass (example; not merged yet)
datasets_binary <- c("GSE15852", "GSE45827","GSE29431","GSE9574","GSE54002", "GSE25066")  # Binary Normal vs Cancer (merged below)

normal_keywords <- c(
  "normal", "non-tumor", "nontumor", "non tumour", "nontumour",
  "healthy", "control", "adjacent normal", "benign", "none"
)

# Preprocessing knobs
enable_auto_log2 <- TRUE
use_fold_downsampling <- TRUE
downsample_max_ratio <- 3
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
load_geo_eset <- function(gse_id) {
  geo_cache_dir <- file.path("data", "geo-cache")
  if (!dir.exists(geo_cache_dir)) dir.create(geo_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Helper: build HTTPS URL for the series matrix
  gse_matrix_url <- function(id, host = "ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov") {
    num <- sub("^GSE", "", id)
    prefix <- substr(num, 1, max(1, nchar(num) - 3))
    series_dir <- paste0("GSE", prefix, "nnn")
    paste0(
      "https://", host, "/geo/series/",
      series_dir, "/", id, "/matrix/",
      id, "_series_matrix.txt.gz"
    )
  }

  # Prefer normal GEOquery path first (uses destdir cache)
  g <- tryCatch(
    GEOquery::getGEO(gse_id, destdir = geo_cache_dir),
    error = function(e) e
  )
  if (!inherits(g, "error")) {
    if (inherits(g, "ExpressionSet")) return(g)
    if (is.list(g) && length(g) >= 1) return(g[[1]])
  }

  # Fallback: explicit HTTPS download with longer timeout + retries + resume, then load from file
  destfile <- file.path(geo_cache_dir, paste0(gse_id, "_series_matrix.txt.gz"))
  urls <- c(
    gse_matrix_url(gse_id, host = "ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov"),
    gse_matrix_url(gse_id, host = "download.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov")
  )

  # R's options(timeout=) does not reliably control libcurl; set curl handle timeout directly.
  h <- curl::new_handle()
  curl::handle_setopt(h,
                      connecttimeout = 60,
                      timeout = 1800,
                      low_speed_time = 300,
                      low_speed_limit = 1000)

  ok <- FALSE
  for (u in urls) {
    for (attempt in 1:6) {
      try({
        size_before <- if (file.exists(destfile)) file.info(destfile)$size else 0
        curl::curl_download(u, destfile, quiet = FALSE, mode = "wb", handle = h, resume = TRUE)
        size_after <- if (file.exists(destfile)) file.info(destfile)$size else 0
        ok <- size_after > 0 && size_after >= size_before
      }, silent = TRUE)
      if (ok) break
      # If we are not making progress, reset the partial file and retry.
      if (file.exists(destfile) && attempt >= 2) file.remove(destfile)
      Sys.sleep(3 * attempt)
    }
    if (ok) break
  }

  if (!ok) {
    stop("Could not download series matrix for ", gse_id, " after retries.\nTried URLs:\n- ",
         paste(urls, collapse = "\n- "))
  }

  g2 <- GEOquery::getGEO(filename = destfile)
  if (inherits(g2, "ExpressionSet")) return(g2)
  if (is.list(g2) && length(g2) >= 1) return(g2[[1]])
  stop("Could not load ExpressionSet for ", gse_id, " from cached file: ", destfile)
}

clean_first_symbol <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || trimws(as.character(s)) == "") return(NA_character_)
  s <- trimws(as.character(s))
  parts <- strsplit(s, " /// ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  trimws(parts[1])
}

needs_log2_transform <- function(e) {
  vals <- as.numeric(e)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (length(vals) < 10) return(FALSE)
  qx <- stats::quantile(vals, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99, 1.0), na.rm = TRUE)
  # GEO2R-style heuristic for identifying non-log expression scales.
  (qx[5] > 100) || (qx[6] - qx[1] > 50 && qx[2] > 0) || (qx[2] > 0 && qx[2] < 1 && qx[4] > 1 && qx[4] < 2)
}

safe_log2_transform <- function(e) {
  pos <- e[e > 0 & is.finite(e)]
  if (!length(pos)) return(e)
  pseudo <- min(pos, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  e2 <- e
  e2[!is.finite(e2)] <- NA_real_
  e2[e2 <= 0] <- pseudo
  log2(e2)
}

collapse_to_genes <- function(eset) {
  e <- exprs(eset)
  q_raw <- stats::quantile(as.numeric(e), probs = c(0.01, 0.5, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  log2_applied <- isTRUE(enable_auto_log2) && needs_log2_transform(e)
  if (log2_applied) {
    e <- safe_log2_transform(e)
  }
  q_used <- stats::quantile(as.numeric(e), probs = c(0.01, 0.5, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  fd <- fData(eset)
  sym_col <- grep("gene\\s*symbol|symbol", colnames(fd), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  gene_sym_raw <- if (!is.na(sym_col)) as.character(fd[, sym_col]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(fd))
has_symbol <- !is.na(gene_sym_raw) & trimws(gene_sym_raw) != ""
gene_sym <- rep(NA_character_, length(gene_sym_raw))
gene_sym[has_symbol] <- vapply(gene_sym_raw[has_symbol], clean_first_symbol, character(1))
  gene_sym <- ifelse(is.na(gene_sym) | gene_sym == "", rownames(e), gene_sym)
  e_g <- limma::avereps(e, ID = gene_sym)

  # Feature table: keep one row per gene symbol where possible, otherwise minimal table
  fd$.__gene_sym__ <- gene_sym
  fd_g <- fd %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(.__gene_sym__ = fd$.__gene_sym__) %>%
    group_by(.__gene_sym__) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(".__gene_sym__")

  list(
    eMat_g = e_g,
    fMat_g = fd_g,
    pMat = pData(eset),
    log2_applied = log2_applied,
    q01_raw = as.numeric(q_raw[1]),
    q50_raw = as.numeric(q_raw[2]),
    q99_raw = as.numeric(q_raw[3]),
    q01_used = as.numeric(q_used[1]),
    q50_used = as.numeric(q_used[2]),
    q99_used = as.numeric(q_used[3])
  )
}

infer_binary_label <- function(pMat, normal_keywords) {
  # Robust text parsing avoids accidental matches like "abnormal"/"normalized".
  normalize_pheno_txt <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    x <- gsub("\u00a0|\u200b", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", x))
    tolower(x)
  }

  flatten_pheno_col <- function(x) {
    if (is.list(x) && !inherits(x, "data.frame")) {
      vapply(x, function(z) paste(as.character(z), collapse = " "), character(1))
    } else {
      as.character(x)
    }
  }

  rx_escape <- function(s) gsub("([][{}()+*^$|\\\\?.])", "\\\\\\1", s, perl = TRUE)

  keyword_hit <- function(xlow, keywords) {
    keywords <- unique(trimws(as.character(keywords)))
    keywords <- keywords[nzchar(keywords)]
    if (!length(keywords)) return(rep(FALSE, length(xlow)))
    parts <- vapply(keywords, function(kw) {
      paste0("(?<![[:alnum:]])", rx_escape(kw), "(?![[:alnum:]])")
    }, character(1))
    grepl(paste0("(?i)(?:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), ")"), xlow, perl = TRUE)
  }

  explicit_normal_rx <- paste0(
    "(?i)(",
    ",\\s*normal\\b|",
    "\\bbreast\\s+biopsy[, ]+normal\\b|",
    "\\bhuman\\s+breast\\s+biopsy[, ]+normal\\b|",
    "\\bnormal\\s+breast(\\s+tissue)?\\b|",
    "tissue:\\s*normal\\b|",
    "histopathological\\s+exam:\\s*normal\\b",
    ")"
  )

  tumor_hint_rx <- "(?i)(tumor|cancer|carcinoma|malign|invasive|ductal|lobular|metasta)"

  cols_try <- local({
    nm <- colnames(pMat)
    pr <- nm[grepl(
      "source_name|sample_title|\\btitle\\b|histology|pathology|disease|diagnosis|tumor|sample_type|biopsy|specimen",
      nm,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )]
    ch <- grep("^characteristics_ch", nm, value = TRUE)
    rest <- setdiff(nm, c(pr, ch))
    unique(c(intersect(pr, nm), ch, rest))
  })

  col_has_signal <- function(xlow) {
    nzchar(xlow) &
      (keyword_hit(xlow, normal_keywords) |
         grepl(explicit_normal_rx, xlow, perl = TRUE) |
         grepl(tumor_hint_rx, xlow, perl = TRUE))
  }

  best <- NULL
  best_key <- NULL

  for (idx in seq_along(cols_try)) {
    cn <- cols_try[[idx]]
    x <- flatten_pheno_col(pMat[[cn]])
    xlow <- normalize_pheno_txt(x)
    if (!any(col_has_signal(xlow))) next

    is_normal <- keyword_hit(xlow, normal_keywords) | grepl(explicit_normal_rx, xlow, perl = TRUE)
    label <- ifelse(is_normal, "Normal", "Cancer")
    label[!nzchar(xlow)] <- NA_character_
    label <- factor(label, levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))

    tab <- table(label, useNA = "no")
    if (!all(c("Cancer", "Normal") %in% names(tab))) next
    if (is.na(tab[["Cancer"]]) || is.na(tab[["Normal"]])) next
    if (tab[["Cancer"]] == 0 || tab[["Normal"]] == 0) next

    min_cnt <- min(as.integer(tab[["Cancer"]]), as.integer(tab[["Normal"]]))
    n_nonempty <- sum(nzchar(xlow) & !is.na(label))
    key <- c(min_cnt, n_nonempty, -idx)
    if (is.null(best_key) || key[1] > best_key[1] ||
        (key[1] == best_key[1] && key[2] > best_key[2]) ||
        (key[1] == best_key[1] && key[2] == best_key[2] && key[3] > best_key[3])) {
      best_key <- key
      best <- list(label = label, label_col = cn)
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(best)) return(best)
  list(label = factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(pMat)), levels = c("Cancer", "Normal")), label_col = NA_character_)
}

extract_after_scalar <- function(x, prefix) {
  # scalar-safe extractor for strings like "pam50_class: Basal"
  if (length(x) > 1) x <- x[which(!is.na(x))[1]]
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  x <- as.character(x)
  m <- regexpr(prefix, x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (m[1] == -1) return(NA_character_)
  out <- substring(x, m[1] + attr(m, "match.length"))
  trimws(out)
}

infer_multiclass_label <- function(pMat) {
  cols_char <- grep("^characteristics_ch", colnames(pMat), value = TRUE)
  cols_other <- setdiff(colnames(pMat), cols_char)
  cols_try <- c(cols_char, cols_other)

  # Prefer columns that look like PAM50
  cols_try <- c(
    intersect(cols_try, grep("pam50", cols_try, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)),
    setdiff(cols_try, grep("pam50", cols_try, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))
  )

  # Canonical subtype dictionary (handles common naming variations across datasets)
  # You can extend this list if you see new spellings.
  subtype_variants <- list(
    "Luminal A"    = c("luminal a", "lum a", "luma", "lum-a", "lum_a", "luminala", "lumina"),
    "Luminal B"    = c("luminal b", "lum b", "lumb", "lum-b", "lum_b", "luminalb"),
    "Basal"        = c("basal", "basal-like", "basal like", "basallike", "basal_like", "basal type", "basaltype", "basal/tumor"),
    "HER2"         = c("her2", "her2+", "her-2", "her 2", "her2-enriched", "her2 enriched", "her2enriched", "erb-b2", "erbb2", "erbb2+", "her2e"),
    "Normal-like"  = c("normal-like", "normal like", "normallike", "normal_like", "normal")
  )

  normalize_label_text <- function(x) {
    x <- tolower(as.character(x))
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    # Light normalization: trim and collapse non-alphanumeric into single spaces
    x <- trimws(gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", " ", x))
    x
  }

  map_to_subtype <- function(x_raw) {
    x_chr <- as.character(x_raw)
    x_norm <- normalize_label_text(x_chr)
    if (x_norm == "") return(NA_character_)

    # If there is a PAM50 tag embedded in the string, parse after it first
    if (grepl("pam50_class", tolower(x_chr), fixed = TRUE)) {
      x_parsed <- extract_after_scalar(x_chr, prefix = "pam50_class:\\s*")
      x_norm <- normalize_label_text(x_parsed)
    }

    # Match against variants (substring match on normalized text)
    for (canon in names(subtype_variants)) {
      v <- subtype_variants[[canon]]
      if (any(vapply(v, function(kw) grepl(kw, x_norm, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)))) {
        return(canon)
      }
    }
    NA_character_
  }

  for (cn in cols_try) {
    x <- as.character(pMat[[cn]])
    lab <- vapply(x, map_to_subtype, character(1))
    y <- factor(lab)
    y <- droplevels(y[!is.na(y)])
    # Accept if 2+ levels and not degenerate
    if (nlevels(y) >= 2) {
      return(list(label = factor(lab), label_col = cn, parsed_pam50 = any(grepl("pam50_class:", x, ignore.case = TRUE))))
    }
  }

  list(label = factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(pMat))), label_col = NA_character_, parsed_pam50 = FALSE)
}

rbind_fill <- function(dfs) {
  all_cols <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(dfs, colnames))
  dfs2 <- lapply(dfs, function(d) {
    miss <- setdiff(all_cols, colnames(d))
    for (m in miss) d[[m]] <- NA
    d[, all_cols, drop = FALSE]
  })
  do.call(rbind, dfs2)
}

# Youden's J threshold (maximises TPR + TNR - 1)
best_threshold_youden <- function(truth, score_pos, positive = "Normal") {
  truth01 <- as.integer(as.character(truth) == positive)
  cand <- sort(unique(score_pos))
  if (length(cand) > 500)
    cand <- quantile(cand, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 500), na.rm = TRUE)
  j <- vapply(cand, function(t) {
    p   <- score_pos >= t
    tpr <- if (sum(truth01) == 0) 0 else sum(p & truth01 == 1) / sum(truth01)
    tnr <- if (sum(1 - truth01) == 0) 0 else sum(!p & truth01 == 0) / sum(1 - truth01)
    tpr + tnr - 1
  }, numeric(1))
  cand[which.max(j)]
}

# Macro-averaged one-vs-rest ROC AUC (multiclass)
macro_auc_ovr <- function(truth, prob_mat) {
  lvls <- colnames(prob_mat)
  aucs <- vapply(lvls, function(k) {
    tk <- as.integer(as.character(truth) == k)
    tk[is.na(tk)] <- 0L          # NA truth rows treated as "not this class"
    n_pos <- sum(tk, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_pos == 0L || n_pos == length(tk)) return(NA_real_)
    auc_roc(tk, prob_mat[, k])
  }, numeric(1))
  mean(aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Platt-scaling calibration
calibrate_platt <- function(scores_df, score_col = "score_normal",
                             truth_col = "truth", positive = "Normal") {
  df  <- data.frame(y = as.integer(as.character(scores_df[[truth_col]]) == positive),
                    s = scores_df[[score_col]])
  fit <- glm(y ~ s, data = df, family = binomial())
  list(fit = fit, positive = positive)
}
apply_calibration_platt <- function(cal, new_scores) {
  as.numeric(predict(cal$fit, newdata = data.frame(s = new_scores), type = "response"))
}

# Per-fold batch correction with a training-only fit.
combat_fit_apply <- function(expr_train, batch_train, mod_train,
                             expr_test, batch_test) {
  if (length(unique(as.character(batch_train))) < 2) {
    message("Single training batch in this LODO fold; skipping batch correction.")
    return(list(train = expr_train, test = expr_test))
  }

  train_batches <- unique(as.character(batch_train))
  test_batches <- unique(as.character(batch_test))
  common_batches <- intersect(train_batches, test_batches)
  novel_test_idx <- which(!(as.character(batch_test) %in% common_batches))

  corrected_train <- tryCatch(
    sva::ComBat(
      dat = expr_train,
      batch = batch_train,
      mod = mod_train,
      par.prior = TRUE,
      mean.only = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("ComBat failed on training fold: ", conditionMessage(e),
              "\n  Falling back to limma::removeBatchEffect for this fold.")
      limma::removeBatchEffect(expr_train, batch = batch_train, design = mod_train)
    }
  )

  corrected_test <- tryCatch({
    batch_train_f <- factor(as.character(batch_train))
    batch_test_f <- factor(as.character(batch_test), levels = levels(batch_train_f))

    batch_means_train <- sapply(levels(batch_train_f), function(b) {
      idx <- which(batch_train_f == b)
      if (length(idx) == 0) return(rep(0, nrow(expr_train)))
      rowMeans(expr_train[, idx, drop = FALSE])
    })

    grand_mean_train <- rowMeans(expr_train)
    expr_test_corrected <- expr_test

    for (b in levels(batch_train_f)) {
      test_in_batch <- which(as.character(batch_test_f) == b)
      if (length(test_in_batch) == 0) next
      batch_effect <- batch_means_train[, b] - grand_mean_train
      expr_test_corrected[, test_in_batch] <-
        expr_test[, test_in_batch, drop = FALSE] - batch_effect
    }

    if (length(novel_test_idx) > 0) {
      message("  Test fold contains ", length(novel_test_idx),
              " samples from unseen batches; applying mean-centering only.")
      sample_means <- colMeans(expr_test[, novel_test_idx, drop = FALSE])
      expr_test_corrected[, novel_test_idx] <-
        sweep(expr_test[, novel_test_idx, drop = FALSE], 2, sample_means, "-") +
        grand_mean_train
    }

    expr_test_corrected
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Test-fold batch correction failed: ", conditionMessage(e),
            "\n  Returning uncorrected test data for this fold.")
    expr_test
  })

  list(train = corrected_train, test = corrected_test)
}

# Missing-value handling for merged expression matrices (use training-fold stats only)
impute_fit <- function(X_train) {
  meds <- apply(X_train, 2, function(v) stats::median(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  meds[is.na(meds)] <- 0
  list(median = meds)
}
impute_apply <- function(X, fit) {
  X2 <- X
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X2))) {
    idx <- is.na(X2[, j])
    if (any(idx)) X2[idx, j] <- fit$median[j]
  }
  X2
}

# Standardisation for distance-based / margin-based models (fit on training only)
standardize_fit <- function(X_train) {
  mu <- colMeans(X_train)
  sdv <- apply(X_train, 2, sd)
  sdv[sdv == 0] <- 1
  list(mu = mu, sd = sdv)
}
standardize_apply <- function(X, fit) {
  sweep(sweep(X, 2, fit$mu, "-"), 2, fit$sd, "/")
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
build_merged_binary_dataset <- function(gse_ids, normal_keywords) {
  pieces <- lapply(gse_ids, function(id) {
    eset <- load_geo_eset(id)
    cc <- collapse_to_genes(eset)
    lab <- infer_binary_label(cc$pMat, normal_keywords)

    p <- cc$pMat
    p$dataset_id <- id
    p$label_col_detected <- lab$label_col
    p$label_binary <- as.character(lab$label)

    list(
      id = id,
      e = cc$eMat_g,
      p = p,
      f = cc$fMat_g,
      log2_applied = cc$log2_applied,
      q01_raw = cc$q01_raw, q50_raw = cc$q50_raw, q99_raw = cc$q99_raw,
      q01_used = cc$q01_used, q50_used = cc$q50_used, q99_used = cc$q99_used
    )
  })

  # Merge expression by INTERSECTION of genes so no dataset-specific padding is needed.
  all_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(pieces, function(x) rownames(x$e)))
  if (length(all_genes) == 0) stop("No genes found across binary datasets.")

  e_big <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pieces, function(x) x$e[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]))

  # Merge phenotype by union of columns
  p_big <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, `[[`, "p"))

  # Merge feature data by union of gene rows (keep only genes present in e_big)
  f_big_all <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, function(x) {
    ff <- x$f
    ff$dataset_id <- x$id
    tibble::rownames_to_column(ff, var = "gene_id")
  }))
  # Keep one row per gene_id (prefer the first dataset that has it)
  f_big <- f_big_all %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% rownames(e_big)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id")

  list(eMat = e_big, pMat = p_big, fMat = f_big, all_genes = all_genes, pieces = pieces)
}

build_merged_multiclass_dataset <- function(gse_ids) {
  pieces <- lapply(gse_ids, function(id) {
    eset <- load_geo_eset(id)
    cc <- collapse_to_genes(eset)
    lab <- infer_multiclass_label(cc$pMat)

    p <- cc$pMat
    p$dataset_id <- id
    p$label_col_detected <- lab$label_col
    p$label_multiclass <- as.character(lab$label)

    list(id = id, e = cc$eMat_g, p = p, f = cc$fMat_g)
  })

  all_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(pieces, function(x) rownames(x$e)))
  if (length(all_genes) == 0) stop("No genes found across multiclass datasets.")

  e_big <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pieces, function(x) x$e[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]))
  p_big <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, `[[`, "p"))

  f_big_all <- rbind_fill(lapply(pieces, function(x) {
    ff <- x$f
    ff$dataset_id <- x$id
    tibble::rownames_to_column(ff, var = "gene_id")
  }))
  f_big <- f_big_all %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% rownames(e_big)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_id")

  list(eMat = e_big, pMat = p_big, fMat = f_big, all_genes = all_genes, pieces = pieces)
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
macro_f1 <- function(truth, pred) {
  truth <- factor(truth)
  pred <- factor(pred, levels = levels(truth))
  lvls <- levels(truth)
  f1s <- c()
  for (k in lvls) {
    tp <- sum(pred == k & truth == k, na.rm = TRUE)
    fp <- sum(pred == k & truth != k, na.rm = TRUE)
    fn <- sum(pred != k & truth == k, na.rm = TRUE)
    prec <- if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fp)
    rec  <- if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn)
    f1   <- if (is.na(prec) || is.na(rec) || (prec + rec) == 0) NA_real_ else 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec)
    f1s <- c(f1s, f1)
  }
  mean(f1s, na.rm = TRUE)
}

select_genes_one_vs_rest <- function(eMat_g, y, n_per_class = 25) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & y != ""
  e <- eMat_g[, ok, drop = FALSE]
  y <- factor(y[ok])

  lvls_orig <- levels(y)
  lvls_safe <- make.names(lvls_orig)
  names(lvls_safe) <- lvls_orig

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + y)
  colnames(design) <- lvls_safe[lvls_orig]
  fit <- lmFit(e, design)

  genes <- character(0)
  for (lvl in lvls_orig) {
    others <- setdiff(lvls_orig, lvl)
    if (length(others) == 0) next
    lvl_s <- unname(lvls_safe[lvl])
    others_s <- unname(lvls_safe[others])
    contrast_str <- paste0(lvl_s, " - (", paste0(others_s, collapse = " + "), ")/", length(others_s))
    cont <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_str, levels = design)
    fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont)
    fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
    tt <- topTable(fit2, n = n_per_class, sort.by = "P")
    genes <- union(genes, rownames(tt))
  }
  genes
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
run_lodo_cv_multiclass <- function(X, y, batch) {
  y <- factor(y)
  batch <- as.character(batch)
  perf <- data.frame()
  all_preds <- data.frame()
  has_multinom <- requireNamespace("nnet", quietly = TRUE)

  for (ds in unique(batch)) {
    test_id <- which(batch == ds)
    train_id <- setdiff(seq_along(batch), test_id)

    y_train <- droplevels(y[train_id])
    y_test <- droplevels(y[test_id])
    if (nlevels(y_train) < 2) next
    if (length(unique(y_test)) < 2) next

    if (!all(levels(y_test) %in% levels(y_train))) {
      y_test <- factor(as.character(y_test), levels = levels(y_train))
    }

    expr_train_raw <- t(X[train_id, , drop = FALSE])
    expr_test_raw <- t(X[test_id, , drop = FALSE])
    batch_train <- batch[train_id]
    batch_test <- batch[test_id]
    mod_train <- model.matrix(~ y_train)

    cb <- combat_fit_apply(
      expr_train = expr_train_raw,
      batch_train = batch_train,
      mod_train = mod_train,
      expr_test = expr_test_raw,
      batch_test = batch_test
    )

    X_train_full <- t(cb$train)
    X_test_full <- t(cb$test)

    genes_sel <- select_genes_one_vs_rest(t(X_train_full), y = y_train, n_per_class = 25)
    sel_genes <- intersect(genes_sel, colnames(X_train_full))
    if (length(sel_genes) < 10) next

    X_train <- X_train_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]
    X_test <- X_test_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]

    imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
    X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
    X_test_i <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

    sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
    X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
    X_test_s <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

    y_test_chr <- as.character(y_test)

    pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7)
    pred_knn_chr <- as.character(pred_knn)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "kNN", fold = ds,
                                   accuracy = mean(pred_knn_chr == y_test_chr),
                                   macro_f1 = macro_f1(y_test_chr, pred_knn_chr)))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "kNN", fold = ds,
                                             truth = y_test_chr, pred = pred_knn_chr))

    svm_fit <- e1071::svm(x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial", cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s))
    pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s)
    pred_svm_chr <- as.character(pred_svm)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "SVM_RBF", fold = ds,
                                   accuracy = mean(pred_svm_chr == y_test_chr),
                                   macro_f1 = macro_f1(y_test_chr, pred_svm_chr)))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "SVM_RBF", fold = ds,
                                             truth = y_test_chr, pred = pred_svm_chr))

    rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train)
    pred_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i)
    pred_rf_chr <- as.character(pred_rf)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "RF", fold = ds,
                                   accuracy = mean(pred_rf_chr == y_test_chr),
                                   macro_f1 = macro_f1(y_test_chr, pred_rf_chr)))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "RF", fold = ds,
                                             truth = y_test_chr, pred = pred_rf_chr))

    if (has_multinom) {
      mn_fit <- nnet::multinom(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s),
                               trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 50000)
      pred_mn <- predict(mn_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s))
      pred_mn_chr <- as.character(pred_mn)
      perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "Multinom", fold = ds,
                                     accuracy = mean(pred_mn_chr == y_test_chr),
                                     macro_f1 = macro_f1(y_test_chr, pred_mn_chr)))
      all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "multiclass", model = "Multinom", fold = ds,
                                               truth = y_test_chr, pred = pred_mn_chr))
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds)
}
```

```{r, fig.cap="Best multiclass model: PCA view with refit predictions on the full merged dataset (visualisation only)."}
fit_predict_best_multiclass <- function(best_model, X, y) {
  y <- factor(y)
  imp <- impute_fit(X)
  X_i <- impute_apply(X, imp)

  if (best_model %in% c("kNN", "SVM_RBF", "Multinom")) {
    sc <- standardize_fit(X_i)
    X_s <- standardize_apply(X_i, sc)
  } else {
    X_s <- X_i
  }

  if (best_model == "kNN") {
    pred <- class::knn(train = X_s, test = X_s, cl = y, k = 7)
    return(list(pred = pred))
  }
  if (best_model == "SVM_RBF") {
    fit <- e1071::svm(x = X_s, y = y, kernel = "radial", cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_s))
    pred <- predict(fit, X_s)
    return(list(pred = pred))
  }
  if (best_model == "RF") {
    fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_s, y = y)
    pred <- predict(fit, X_s)
    return(list(pred = pred))
  }
  if (best_model == "Multinom") {
    if (!requireNamespace("nnet", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'nnet' not installed; can't fit Multinom.")
    fit <- nnet::multinom(y ~ ., data = data.frame(y = y, X_s), trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 50000)
    pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(X_s))
    return(list(pred = pred))
  }
  stop("Unknown multiclass model name: ", best_model)
}
```

## Model zoo + LODO CV (binary: merged datasets)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
auc_roc <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  truth_pos <- as.integer(truth_pos)
  score_pos <- as.numeric(score_pos)
  pos <- truth_pos == 1
  neg <- truth_pos == 0
  n_pos <- sum(pos)
  n_neg <- sum(neg)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(score_pos, ties.method = "average")
  (sum(r[pos]) - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
}

pr_curve_df <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  ord <- order(score_pos, decreasing = TRUE)
  y <- as.integer(truth_pos[ord])
  s <- score_pos[ord]
  tp <- cumsum(y == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(y == 0)
  fn_total <- sum(y == 1)
  precision <- tp / pmax(tp + fp, 1)
  recall <- tp / pmax(fn_total, 1)
  tibble(threshold = s, precision = precision, recall = recall)
}

auc_pr <- function(truth_pos, score_pos) {
  df <- pr_curve_df(truth_pos, score_pos)
  if (nrow(df) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  o <- order(df$recall, df$precision)
  x <- df$recall[o]
  y <- df$precision[o]
  sum(diff(x) * (head(y, -1) + tail(y, -1)) / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
}

binary_metrics <- function(truth, pred, positive = "Normal") {
  keep <- !(is.na(truth) | is.na(pred))
  truth <- factor(as.character(truth[keep]))
  pred <- factor(as.character(pred[keep]), levels = levels(truth))
  if (length(truth) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      accuracy = NA_real_,
      balanced_accuracy = NA_real_,
      recall_normal = NA_real_,
      precision_normal = NA_real_,
      f1_normal = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tp <- sum(truth == positive & pred == positive)
  fn <- sum(truth == positive & pred != positive)
  tn <- sum(truth != positive & pred != positive)
  fp <- sum(truth != positive & pred == positive)

  recall_pos <- if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn)
  precision_pos <- if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fp)
  f1_pos <- if (is.na(recall_pos) || is.na(precision_pos) || (recall_pos + precision_pos) == 0) NA_real_ else {
    2 * recall_pos * precision_pos / (recall_pos + precision_pos)
  }
  specificity <- if ((tn + fp) == 0) NA_real_ else tn / (tn + fp)
  bal_acc <- mean(c(recall_pos, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  acc <- mean(truth == pred)

  tibble(
    accuracy = acc,
    balanced_accuracy = bal_acc,
    recall_normal = recall_pos,
    precision_normal = precision_pos,
    f1_normal = f1_pos
  )
}

best_threshold_f1 <- function(truth, score_pos, positive = "Normal") {
  truth <- as.character(truth)
  neg <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(truth)), positive)[1]
  if (is.na(neg) || length(neg) == 0) return(0.5)
  cand <- sort(unique(score_pos))
  if (length(cand) > 200) cand <- quantile(cand, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1 <- sapply(cand, function(t) {
    pred <- ifelse(score_pos >= t, positive, neg)
    m <- binary_metrics(truth, pred, positive = positive)
    m$f1_normal
  })
  cand[which.max(f1)]
}
```

```{r}
run_lodo_cv_binary <- function(X, y, batch, positive = "Normal", use_weights = TRUE,
                               apply_batch_correction = TRUE,
                               weight_scheme = c("ratio", "balanced", "balanced_capped"),
                               weight_cap = 4,
                               use_downsampling = TRUE,
                               downsample_ratio_cap = 3) {
  y <- factor(y)
  batch <- as.character(batch)
  weight_scheme <- match.arg(weight_scheme)
  setting_label <- if (!isTRUE(use_weights)) {
    "unweighted"
  } else if (weight_scheme == "ratio") {
    "weighted_ratio"
  } else if (weight_scheme == "balanced") {
    "weighted_balanced"
  } else {
    paste0("weighted_balanced_cap", format(weight_cap, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE))
  }
  perf <- data.frame()
  all_preds <- data.frame()
  all_scores <- data.frame()
  fold_diag <- data.frame()

  for (ds in unique(batch)) {
    test_id <- which(batch == ds)
    train_id <- setdiff(seq_along(batch), test_id)

    y_train <- droplevels(y[train_id])
    y_test <- droplevels(y[test_id])
    if (nlevels(y_train) < 2) {
      message("Skipping binary fold ", ds, ": training has < 2 classes.")
      next
    }
    if (!all(levels(y_test) %in% levels(y_train))) {
      message("Skipping binary fold ", ds, ": test contains class(es) not present in training.")
      next
    }
    y_test <- factor(as.character(y_test), levels = levels(y_train))
    if (length(unique(y_test)) < 2) next

    expr_train_raw <- t(X[train_id, , drop = FALSE])
    expr_test_raw <- t(X[test_id, , drop = FALSE])
    batch_train <- batch[train_id]
    batch_test <- batch[test_id]

    n_pos_before <- sum(y_train == positive)
    n_neg_before <- sum(y_train != positive)

    downsample_applied <- FALSE
    if (isTRUE(use_downsampling)) {
      idx_pos <- which(y_train == positive)
      idx_neg <- which(y_train != positive)
      if (length(idx_pos) > 0 && length(idx_neg) > 0) {
        max_n <- function(n_min) max(1L, as.integer(downsample_ratio_cap * n_min))
        keep_idx <- seq_along(y_train)
        if (length(idx_neg) > max_n(length(idx_pos))) {
          keep_idx <- sort(c(idx_pos, sample(idx_neg, max_n(length(idx_pos)))))
        } else if (length(idx_pos) > max_n(length(idx_neg))) {
          keep_idx <- sort(c(sample(idx_pos, max_n(length(idx_neg))), idx_neg))
        }
        if (length(keep_idx) < length(y_train)) {
          downsample_applied <- TRUE
          y_train <- droplevels(y_train[keep_idx])
          expr_train_raw <- expr_train_raw[, keep_idx, drop = FALSE]
          batch_train <- batch_train[keep_idx]
        }
      }
    }
    mod_train <- model.matrix(~ y_train)

    cb <- if (isTRUE(apply_batch_correction)) {
      combat_fit_apply(
        expr_train = expr_train_raw,
        batch_train = batch_train,
        mod_train = mod_train,
        expr_test = expr_test_raw,
        batch_test = batch_test
      )
    } else {
      list(train = expr_train_raw, test = expr_test_raw)
    }

    X_train_full <- t(cb$train)
    X_test_full <- t(cb$test)

    if (nrow(X_train_full) == 0 || ncol(X_train_full) == 0 || all(is.na(X_train_full))) {
      message("Skipping binary fold ", ds, ": corrected training matrix is empty or all NA.")
      next
    }

    design_train <- model.matrix(~ y_train)
    fit_lm <- tryCatch(
      eBayes(lmFit(t(X_train_full), design_train)),
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Skipping binary fold ", ds,
          ": lmFit failed (samples=", nrow(X_train_full),
          ", genes=", ncol(X_train_full),
          ", NA_fraction=", round(mean(is.na(X_train_full)), 4),
          ") -> ", conditionMessage(e)
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(fit_lm)) next
    top_genes <- topTable(fit_lm, n = 50, sort.by = "P")
    sel_genes <- intersect(rownames(top_genes), colnames(X_train_full))
    if (length(sel_genes) < 10) next

    X_train <- X_train_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]
    X_test <- X_test_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]

    imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
    X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
    X_test_i <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

    sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
    X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
    X_test_s <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

    n_pos <- sum(y_train == positive)
    n_neg <- sum(y_train != positive)

    if (isTRUE(use_weights)) {
      if (weight_scheme == "ratio") {
        pos_w <- if (n_pos > 0) n_neg / n_pos else 1
        neg_w <- 1
      } else {
        n_total <- n_pos + n_neg
        pos_w <- if (n_pos > 0) n_total / (2 * n_pos) else 1
        neg_w <- if (n_neg > 0) n_total / (2 * n_neg) else 1
        if (weight_scheme == "balanced_capped") {
          pos_w <- min(pos_w, weight_cap)
          neg_w <- min(neg_w, weight_cap)
        }
      }
    } else {
      pos_w <- 1
      neg_w <- 1
    }

    n_pos_after <- sum(y_train == positive)
    n_neg_after <- sum(y_train != positive)
    fold_diag <- rbind(fold_diag, data.frame(
      setting = setting_label,
      fold = ds,
      positive_class = positive,
      n_train_before = as.integer(n_pos_before + n_neg_before),
      n_pos_before = as.integer(n_pos_before),
      n_neg_before = as.integer(n_neg_before),
      n_train_after = as.integer(n_pos_after + n_neg_after),
      n_pos_after = as.integer(n_pos_after),
      n_neg_after = as.integer(n_neg_after),
      downsample_used = isTRUE(use_downsampling),
      downsample_applied = downsample_applied,
      downsample_ratio_cap = downsample_ratio_cap,
      pos_weight = as.numeric(pos_w),
      neg_weight = as.numeric(neg_w),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))

    neg_label <- setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1]
    cw <- c()
    cw[positive] <- pos_w
    cw[neg_label] <- neg_w

    pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7, prob = TRUE)
    win_prob <- attr(pred_knn, "prob")
    score_knn <- ifelse(pred_knn == positive, win_prob, 1 - win_prob)
    m_knn <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_knn, positive = positive)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                   model = "kNN", fold = ds, m_knn))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                             model = "kNN", fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_knn))
    all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                               model = "kNN", fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = score_knn))

    svm_fit <- e1071::svm(
      x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial",
      cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s),
      probability = TRUE,
      class.weights = if (use_weights) cw else NULL
    )
    pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s, probability = TRUE)
    prob_svm <- attr(pred_svm, "probabilities")
    score_svm <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_svm)) prob_svm[, "Normal"] else prob_svm[, 1]
    m_svm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_svm, positive = positive)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                   model = ifelse(use_weights, "SVM_RBF_w", "SVM_RBF"),
                                   fold = ds, m_svm))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                             model = ifelse(use_weights, "SVM_RBF_w", "SVM_RBF"),
                                             fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_svm))
    all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                               model = ifelse(use_weights, "SVM_RBF_w", "SVM_RBF"),
                                               fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = score_svm))

    rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train, classwt = if (use_weights) cw else NULL)
    pred_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i)
    prob_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i, type = "prob")
    score_rf <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_rf)) prob_rf[, "Normal"] else prob_rf[, 1]
    m_rf <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_rf, positive = positive)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                   model = ifelse(use_weights, "RF_w", "RF"),
                                   fold = ds, m_rf))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                             model = ifelse(use_weights, "RF_w", "RF"),
                                             fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_rf))
    all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                               model = ifelse(use_weights, "RF_w", "RF"),
                                               fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = score_rf))

    w <- if (use_weights) ifelse(y_train == positive, pos_w, neg_w) else rep(1, length(y_train))
    glm_fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s),
                   family = binomial(), weights = w)
    p_hat <- predict(glm_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s), type = "response")
    pred_glm <- ifelse(p_hat >= 0.5, positive, setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1])
    pred_glm <- factor(pred_glm, levels = levels(y_train))
    m_glm <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_glm, positive = positive)
    perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                   model = ifelse(use_weights, "Logistic_w", "Logistic"),
                                   fold = ds, m_glm))
    all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                             model = ifelse(use_weights, "Logistic_w", "Logistic"),
                                             fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_glm))
    all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                               model = ifelse(use_weights, "Logistic_w", "Logistic"),
                                               fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = p_hat))

    if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
      x_train_mat <- as.matrix(X_train_s)
      x_test_mat <- as.matrix(X_test_s)
      y_train_num <- as.numeric(y_train == positive)
      lasso_fit <- tryCatch(
        glmnet::cv.glmnet(
          x = x_train_mat,
          y = y_train_num,
          family = "binomial",
          alpha = 1,
          weights = w,
          standardize = FALSE
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          message("Skipping Lasso fold ", ds, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
          NULL
        }
      )
      if (!is.null(lasso_fit)) {
        p_lasso <- as.numeric(predict(lasso_fit, newx = x_test_mat, type = "response", s = "lambda.min"))
        pred_lasso <- ifelse(p_lasso >= 0.5, positive, setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1])
        pred_lasso <- factor(pred_lasso, levels = levels(y_train))
        m_lasso <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_lasso, positive = positive)
        perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                       model = ifelse(use_weights, "Lasso_w", "Lasso"),
                                       fold = ds, m_lasso))
        all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                 model = ifelse(use_weights, "Lasso_w", "Lasso"),
                                                 fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_lasso))
        all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                   model = ifelse(use_weights, "Lasso_w", "Lasso"),
                                                   fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = p_lasso))
      }
    }

    # --- ElasticNet (alpha = 0.5) ---
    if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
      enet_fit <- tryCatch(
        glmnet::cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(X_train_s), y = as.numeric(y_train == positive),
                          family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5, weights = w, standardize = FALSE),
        error = function(e) { message("ElasticNet fold ", ds, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }
      )
      if (!is.null(enet_fit)) {
        p_enet    <- as.numeric(predict(enet_fit, newx = as.matrix(X_test_s),
                                        type = "response", s = "lambda.min"))
        pred_enet <- factor(ifelse(p_enet >= 0.5, positive, neg_label), levels = levels(y_train))
        m_enet    <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_enet, positive = positive)
        perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                       model = ifelse(use_weights, "ElasticNet_w", "ElasticNet"),
                                       fold = ds, m_enet))
        all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                  model = ifelse(use_weights, "ElasticNet_w", "ElasticNet"),
                                                  fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_enet))
        all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                    model = ifelse(use_weights, "ElasticNet_w", "ElasticNet"),
                                                    fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = p_enet))
      }
    }

    # --- XGBoost ---
    if (requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
      y_num_xgb  <- as.numeric(y_train == positive)
      xgb_dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_train_s), label = y_num_xgb, weight = w)
      xgb_dtest  <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_test_s))
      xgb_fit <- tryCatch(
        xgboost::xgb.train(
          params  = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                         eta = 0.05, max_depth = 4, subsample = 0.8,
                         colsample_bytree = 0.8, min_child_weight = 5, nthread = 1),
          data    = xgb_dtrain,
          nrounds = 150,
          verbose = 0
        ),
        error = function(e) { message("XGBoost fold ", ds, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }
      )
      if (!is.null(xgb_fit)) {
        p_xgb    <- as.numeric(predict(xgb_fit, xgb_dtest))
        pred_xgb <- factor(ifelse(p_xgb >= 0.5, positive, neg_label), levels = levels(y_train))
        m_xgb    <- binary_metrics(y_test, pred_xgb, positive = positive)
        perf <- rbind(perf, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                       model = ifelse(use_weights, "XGB_w", "XGB"),
                                       fold = ds, m_xgb))
        all_preds <- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                  model = ifelse(use_weights, "XGB_w", "XGB"),
                                                  fold = ds, truth = y_test, pred = pred_xgb))
        all_scores <- rbind(all_scores, data.frame(task = "binary", setting = setting_label,
                                                    model = ifelse(use_weights, "XGB_w", "XGB"),
                                                    fold = ds, truth = y_test, score_normal = p_xgb))
      }
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds, scores = all_scores, diag = fold_diag)
}

weight_cfg <- tibble::tribble(
  ~use_weights, ~weight_scheme, ~weight_cap,
  FALSE, "ratio", Inf,
  TRUE, "ratio", Inf,
  TRUE, "balanced", Inf,
  TRUE, "balanced_capped", 4
)

bin_runs <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(weight_cfg)), function(i) {
  cfg <- weight_cfg[i, ]
  run_lodo_cv_binary(
    X = X_bin,
    y = y_bin2,
    batch = batch_bin,
    positive = "Normal",
    use_weights = cfg$use_weights,
    apply_batch_correction = TRUE,
    weight_scheme = cfg$weight_scheme,
    weight_cap = cfg$weight_cap,
    use_downsampling = use_fold_downsampling,
    downsample_ratio_cap = downsample_max_ratio
  )
})

perf_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(bin_runs, `[[`, "perf"))
preds_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(bin_runs, `[[`, "preds"))
scores_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(bin_runs, `[[`, "scores"))
diag_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(bin_runs, `[[`, "diag"))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
```

```{r, fig.cap="Binary: pooled ROC and PR curves for the best model."}
curve_best <- scores_bin %>% filter(setting == best_setting_bin, model == best_model_bin)
truth01 <- as.integer(curve_best$truth == "Normal")
score <- curve_best$score_normal

# ROC points
roc_thresh <- sort(unique(score), decreasing = TRUE)
roc_df <- lapply(roc_thresh, function(t) {
  pred <- score >= t
  tp <- sum(pred & truth01 == 1)
  fn <- sum(!pred & truth01 == 1)
  fp <- sum(pred & truth01 == 0)
  tn <- sum(!pred & truth01 == 0)
  tibble(
    threshold = t,
    tpr = if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn),
    fpr = if ((fp + tn) == 0) NA_real_ else fp / (fp + tn)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

pr_df <- pr_curve_df(truth01, score)

p1 <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    title = paste0("ROC curve (AUC = ", round(auc_roc(truth01, score), 3), ")")
  )

p2 <- ggplot(pr_df, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
  geom_line(color = "#41AB5D", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Recall (Normal)",
    y = "Precision (Normal)",

  )
```

```{r}
# Binary: aggregate metrics table (mean \u00B1 SD) plus ROC/PR AUC across all weight settings

model_auc <- scores_bin %>%
  group_by(setting, model) %>%
  summarise(
    roc_auc = auc_roc(truth == "Normal", score_normal),
    pr_auc = auc_pr(truth == "Normal", score_normal),
    .groups = "drop"

model_summary <- perf_bin %>%
  group_by(setting, model) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy_mean = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    accuracy_sd = sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    balanced_accuracy_mean = mean(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    balanced_accuracy_sd = sd(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sensitivity_mean = mean(recall_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    sensitivity_sd = sd(recall_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    precision_mean = mean(precision_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    precision_sd = sd(precision_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    f1_mean = mean(f1_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    f1_sd = sd(f1_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(model_auc, by = c("setting", "model")) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_roc = dense_rank(desc(roc_auc)),
    rank_pr = dense_rank(desc(pr_auc)),
    rank_recall = dense_rank(desc(sensitivity_mean))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(roc_auc), desc(pr_auc), desc(sensitivity_mean), desc(accuracy_mean)) %>%
  mutate(overall_rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(overall_rank, setting, model, rank_roc, rank_pr, rank_recall,
         accuracy_mean, accuracy_sd, balanced_accuracy_mean, balanced_accuracy_sd,
         sensitivity_mean, sensitivity_sd, precision_mean, precision_sd, f1_mean, f1_sd,
         roc_auc, pr_auc) %>%
  mutate(
    accuracy = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", accuracy_mean, accuracy_sd),
    balanced_accuracy = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", balanced_accuracy_mean, balanced_accuracy_sd),
    sensitivity = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", sensitivity_mean, sensitivity_sd),
    precision = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", precision_mean, precision_sd),
    f1 = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", f1_mean, f1_sd),
    roc_auc = round(roc_auc, 3),
    pr_auc = round(pr_auc, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(overall_rank, setting, model, rank_roc, rank_pr, rank_recall,
         accuracy, balanced_accuracy, sensitivity, precision, f1, roc_auc, pr_auc)

knitr::kable(model_summary, caption = "Binary: model scorecard ranked by ROC AUC, then PR AUC, then recall")
```

## How many DE genes do we need? (binary)

```{r, fig.cap="Binary: best balanced accuracy vs number of DE genes (weighted models only)."}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Goal: find the smallest top-N DE gene set that achieves strong performance.
# We evaluate a grid of N, run the weighted leave-one-dataset-out CV once per N, and take the best mean balanced accuracy across models.

de_gene_sweep <- function(e_bin_de, y_bin_de, n_grid = c(5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200),
                          K = 4, repeats = 10, positive = "Normal") {
  if (nrow(e_bin_de) == 0 || ncol(e_bin_de) == 0 || all(is.na(e_bin_de))) {
    message("Skipping DE sweep: expression matrix is empty or all NA.")
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_genes = integer(0),
      best_model = character(0),
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  design_bin <- model.matrix(~ y_bin_de)
  fit_bin <- tryCatch(
    eBayes(lmFit(e_bin_de, design_bin)),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Skipping DE sweep: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(fit_bin)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_genes = integer(0),
      best_model = character(0),
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  out <- list()
  for (n_genes in n_grid) {
    tt <- topTable(fit_bin, n = n_genes, sort.by = "P")
    genes <- rownames(tt)
    X <- t(e_bin_de[intersect(genes, rownames(e_bin_de)), , drop = FALSE])

    # If something went wrong (e.g., no overlap), skip safely
    if (ncol(X) < 2) next

    batch_de <- pMat_big_bin$dataset_id[ok_bin_de]
    res_w <- run_lodo_cv_binary(X, y_bin_de, batch_de, positive = positive, use_weights = TRUE)
    perf_w <- res_w$perf

    if (nrow(perf_w) == 0 || !"model" %in% names(perf_w)) {
      out[[as.character(n_genes)]] <- data.frame(
        n_genes = n_genes,
        best_model = NA_character_,
        best_mean_balanced_accuracy = NA_real_
      )
      next
    }

    best <- perf_w %>%
      group_by(model) %>%
      summarise(mean_bal_acc = mean(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_bal_acc)) %>%
      slice(1)

    out[[as.character(n_genes)]] <- data.frame(
      n_genes = n_genes,
      best_model = best$model[1],
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = best$mean_bal_acc[1]
    )
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

sweep_res <- de_gene_sweep(e_bin_de, y_bin_de,
                          n_grid = c(5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200),
                          K = 4, repeats = 10, positive = "Normal")

knitr::kable(sweep_res, caption = "Binary DE gene sweep (weighted CV): best mean balanced accuracy by top-N DE genes")

ggplot(sweep_res, aes(x = n_genes, y = best_mean_balanced_accuracy)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sweep_res$n_genes) +
  labs(x = "Top-N DE genes", y = "Best mean balanced accuracy (weighted CV)", title = "How many DE genes do we need?") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## QC inclusion criteria overview (per dataset)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
qc_summary_from_piece <- function(piece, task = c("binary", "multiclass")) {
  task <- match.arg(task)
  p <- piece$p
  e <- piece$e
  f <- piece$f

  label_col <- unique(as.character(p$label_col_detected))
  label_col <- label_col[!is.na(label_col) & label_col != ""]
  label_col <- if (length(label_col) > 0) label_col[1] else NA_character_

  label_vec <- if (task == "binary") as.character(p$label_binary) else as.character(p$label_multiclass)
  label_vec[is.na(label_vec) | trimws(label_vec) == ""] <- NA_character_
  n_labeled <- sum(!is.na(label_vec))
  n_classes <- dplyr::n_distinct(label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)])

  # Heuristic: if metadata says normalized / log transformed, mark yes.
  p_text <- tolower(apply(as.data.frame(p), 1, function(r) paste(r, collapse = " | ")))
  has_norm_meta <- any(grepl("normaliz|log2|rma|mas5|quantile", p_text))

  # Gene symbol coverage proxy: proportion of feature rownames that look like symbols.
  gene_ids <- rownames(f)
  gene_symbol_like <- mean(grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\\-\\.]{1,}$", gene_ids))

  tibble::tibble(
    dataset_id = piece$id,
    task = task,
    n_samples = ncol(e),
    n_genes_after_collapse = nrow(e),
    normalized_data = ifelse(has_norm_meta, "Likely (metadata indicates transformed/normalized)", "Likely (series matrix); explicit flag not found"),
    outcome_variable_clear = ifelse(!is.na(label_col) && n_classes >= 2, "Yes", "No / unclear"),
    detected_outcome_column = ifelse(is.na(label_col), "NA", label_col),
    labeled_samples = n_labeled,
    classes_detected = n_classes,
    gene_symbols_available = sprintf("%.1f%% symbol-like rownames", 100 * gene_symbol_like),
    include_in_merge = ifelse(n_labeled >= 10 && n_classes >= 2, "Include", "Exclude (insufficient/unclear labels)")
  )
}

qc_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(merged_bin$pieces, qc_summary_from_piece, task = "binary"))
qc_mc  <- bind_rows(lapply(merged_mc$pieces,  qc_summary_from_piece, task = "multiclass"))
qc_table <- bind_rows(qc_bin, qc_mc) %>% arrange(task, dataset_id)

knitr::kable(qc_table, caption = "QC inclusion criteria overview by dataset")
```

## Does adding more datasets help? (AUC vs number of datasets)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
dataset_count_auc_sweep <- function(dataset_ids, normal_keywords,
                                    top_n_genes = 50, K = 4, repeats = 8,
                                    positive = "Normal") {
  out <- list()

  for (k in seq_along(dataset_ids)) {
    ids_k <- dataset_ids[seq_len(k)]
    merged_k <- build_merged_binary_dataset(ids_k, normal_keywords)

    ok_k <- !is.na(merged_k$pMat$label_binary) & merged_k$pMat$label_binary != ""
    y_k <- factor(merged_k$pMat$label_binary[ok_k], levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))
    e_k <- merged_k$eMat[, ok_k, drop = FALSE]
    if (nlevels(droplevels(y_k)) < 2) next
    if (nrow(e_k) == 0 || ncol(e_k) == 0 || all(is.na(e_k))) next

    design_k <- model.matrix(~ y_k)
    fit_k <- tryCatch(
      eBayes(lmFit(e_k, design_k)),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Skipping dataset prefix ", k, " in dataset sweep: ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(fit_k)) next
    top_k <- topTable(fit_k, n = top_n_genes, sort.by = "P")
    genes_k <- rownames(top_k)
    X_k <- t(e_k[intersect(genes_k, rownames(e_k)), , drop = FALSE])
    if (ncol(X_k) < 2 || nrow(X_k) < (K + 2)) next

    batch_k <- merged_k$pMat$dataset_id[ok_k]
    res_k <- run_lodo_cv_binary(X_k, y_k, batch_k, positive = positive, use_weights = TRUE)

    req_cols <- c("model", "truth", "score_normal")
    if (!is.data.frame(res_k$scores) || nrow(res_k$scores) == 0 ||
        !all(req_cols %in% names(res_k$scores))) {
      message("Skipping dataset prefix ", k, ": score output is empty or missing required columns.")
      next
    }

    auc_k <- tryCatch({
      res_k$scores %>%
        group_by(model) %>%
        summarise(
          roc_auc = auc_roc(truth == positive, score_normal),
          pr_auc = auc_pr(truth == positive, score_normal),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(roc_auc))
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Skipping dataset prefix ", k, " during AUC summary: ", conditionMessage(e))
      tibble::tibble()
    })

    if (nrow(auc_k) == 0) next

    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble::tibble(
      n_datasets = k,
      datasets_used = paste(ids_k, collapse = ","),
      n_samples = nrow(X_k),
      best_model = auc_k$model[1],
      best_roc_auc = auc_k$roc_auc[1],
      best_pr_auc = auc_k$pr_auc[1]
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}

dataset_auc_res <- dataset_count_auc_sweep(

  normal_keywords = normal_keywords,
  top_n_genes = 50, K = 4, repeats = 8, positive = "Normal"
```

## Cross-Dataset Generalization Heatmap

```{r, fig.cap="Heatmap of external validation ROC AUC across all pairwise combinations of binary datasets (columns = test set, rows = training set)."}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
compute_cross_dataset_matrix <- function(dataset_ids, eMat_big, pMat_big, target_genes, positive = "Normal") {
  n <- length(dataset_ids)
  auc_mat <- matrix(NA, n, n, dimnames = list(Train = dataset_ids, Test = dataset_ids))
  
  # For safety, pre-extract the unified datasets
  ok_bin <- !is.na(pMat_big$label_binary) & pMat_big$label_binary != ""
  p_valid <- pMat_big[ok_bin, ]
  e_valid <- eMat_big[intersect(target_genes, rownames(eMat_big)), ok_bin, drop = FALSE]
  
  for (i in seq_along(dataset_ids)) {
    id_train <- dataset_ids[i]
    idx_train <- which(p_valid$dataset_id == id_train)
    if (length(idx_train) == 0) next
    
    y_train <- factor(p_valid$label_binary[idx_train], levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))
    X_train <- t(e_valid[, idx_train, drop = FALSE])
    
    if (nlevels(droplevels(y_train)) < 2) next
    
    imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
    X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
    sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
    X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
    
    tab <- table(y_train)
    w_train <- ifelse(y_train == positive, as.numeric(tab["Cancer"] / max(1, tab["Normal"])), 1)
    
    fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s),
               family = binomial(), weights = w_train)
    
    for (j in seq_along(dataset_ids)) {
      id_test <- dataset_ids[j]
      idx_test <- which(p_valid$dataset_id == id_test)
      if (length(idx_test) == 0) next
      
      y_test <- factor(p_valid$label_binary[idx_test], levels = c("Cancer", "Normal"))
      X_test <- t(e_valid[, idx_test, drop = FALSE])
      
      if (nlevels(droplevels(y_test)) < 2) next
      
      X_test_s <- standardize_apply(impute_apply(X_test, imp), sc)
      
      # The score returned is P(Y="Normal")
      p_hat <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s), type = "response")
      auc_mat[i, j] <- auc_roc(y_test == positive, p_hat)
    }
  }
  auc_mat
}

cross_auc_mat <- compute_cross_dataset_matrix(
  dataset_ids = datasets_binary,
  eMat_big = eMat_big_bin, 
  pMat_big = pMat_big_bin, 
  target_genes = genes_bin, 
  positive = "Normal"
)

# Convert to long format for ggplot heatmap
cross_auc_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cross_auc_mat))
colnames(cross_auc_df) <- c("Train", "Test", "AUC")

ggplot(cross_auc_df, aes(x = Test, y = Train, fill = AUC)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", AUC)), color = ifelse(is.na(cross_auc_df$AUC) | cross_auc_df$AUC > 0.75, "white", "black"), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B", na.value = "grey90") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Test Dataset (Evaluation)", 
    y = "Train Dataset (Fit)", 
    title = "Cross-Dataset Model Generalization (Logistic Regression ROC AUC)",
    fill = "ROC AUC"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
de_gene_sweep_auc <- function(e_bin_de, y_bin_de, n_grid = c(5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200),
                              K = 4, repeats = 8, positive = "Normal") {
  if (nrow(e_bin_de) == 0 || ncol(e_bin_de) == 0 || all(is.na(e_bin_de))) {
    message("Skipping DE sweep AUC: expression matrix is empty or all NA.")
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_genes = integer(0),
      best_model_bal_acc = character(0),
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = numeric(0),
      best_model_auc = character(0),
      best_roc_auc = numeric(0),
      best_pr_auc = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  design_bin <- model.matrix(~ y_bin_de)
  fit_bin <- tryCatch(
    eBayes(lmFit(e_bin_de, design_bin)),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Skipping DE sweep AUC: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(fit_bin)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_genes = integer(0),
      best_model_bal_acc = character(0),
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = numeric(0),
      best_model_auc = character(0),
      best_roc_auc = numeric(0),
      best_pr_auc = numeric(0)
    ))
  }
  out <- list()

  for (n_genes in n_grid) {
    tt <- topTable(fit_bin, n = n_genes, sort.by = "P")
    genes <- rownames(tt)
    X <- t(e_bin_de[intersect(genes, rownames(e_bin_de)), , drop = FALSE])
    if (ncol(X) < 2) next

    batch_de <- pMat_big_bin$dataset_id[ok_bin_de]
    res_w <- run_lodo_cv_binary(X, y_bin_de, batch_de, positive = positive, use_weights = TRUE)

    if (nrow(res_w$perf) == 0 || !"model" %in% names(res_w$perf) ||
        nrow(res_w$scores) == 0 || !"model" %in% names(res_w$scores)) {
      out[[as.character(n_genes)]] <- tibble::tibble(
        n_genes = n_genes,
        best_model_bal_acc = NA_character_,
        best_mean_balanced_accuracy = NA_real_,
        best_model_auc = NA_character_,
        best_roc_auc = NA_real_,
        best_pr_auc = NA_real_
      )
      next
    }

    perf_best <- res_w$perf %>%
      group_by(model) %>%
      summarise(mean_bal_acc = mean(balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_bal_acc)) %>%
      slice(1)

    auc_by_model <- res_w$scores %>%
      group_by(model) %>%
      summarise(
        roc_auc = auc_roc(truth == positive, score_normal),
        pr_auc = auc_pr(truth == positive, score_normal),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(roc_auc))

    out[[as.character(n_genes)]] <- tibble::tibble(
      n_genes = n_genes,
      best_model_bal_acc = perf_best$model[1],
      best_mean_balanced_accuracy = perf_best$mean_bal_acc[1],
      best_model_auc = auc_by_model$model[1],
      best_roc_auc = auc_by_model$roc_auc[1],
      best_pr_auc = auc_by_model$pr_auc[1]
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}
```

```{r}
# Extract Clinical Metadata (Age, Gender, Location)
p_risk <- pMat_big_bin[ok_bin_de, ]
extract_metadata_cols <- function(p) {
  df <- data.frame(sample = rownames(p), age = NA_real_, gender = NA_character_, location = NA_character_)
  chars <- p[, grep("^characteristics_ch", colnames(p)), drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(chars) == 0) return(df)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(p))) {
    row_text <- tolower(paste(chars[i, ], collapse = " "))
    
    # Age extraction
    m_age <- regexpr("age[^a-z0-9]*([0-9]{1,3})", row_text)
    if (m_age > 0) df$age[i] <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", regmatches(row_text, m_age)))
    
    # Gender extraction
    if (grepl("female", row_text)) {
       df$gender[i] <- "Female"
    } else if (grepl("male[\\s,;]?", row_text)) {
       df$gender[i] <- "Male"
    }
    
    # Location / Country
    m_loc <- regexpr("country[:\\s]*([a-z]+)", row_text)
    if (m_loc > 0) df$location[i] <- gsub("country[:\\s]*", "", regmatches(row_text, m_loc))
  }
  df
}

risk_band <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.20, "Low",
         ifelse(p < 0.50, "Intermediate", "High"))
}

# Risk calculator reports that mirror the classification pipeline.
summarise_risk_report <- function(perf_df, scores_df, report_label) {
  risk_scores_df <- scores_df %>%
    mutate(
      p_normal = score_normal,
      p_cancer = 1 - score_normal,
      risk_score = qlogis(pmin(pmax(p_normal, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)),
      risk_band = risk_band(p_cancer),
      sample_id = paste0("fold_", fold, "_", row_number())
    )

  risk_metrics_df <- risk_scores_df %>%
    group_by(setting, model) %>%
    summarise(
      roc_auc = auc_roc(truth == "Normal", score_normal),
      pr_auc = auc_pr(truth == "Normal", score_normal),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      perf_df %>%
        group_by(setting, model) %>%
        summarise(
          accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
          recall = mean(recall_normal, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        ),
      by = c("setting", "model")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rank_roc = dense_rank(desc(roc_auc)),
      rank_pr = dense_rank(desc(pr_auc)),
      rank_recall = dense_rank(desc(recall))
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(roc_auc), desc(pr_auc), desc(recall), desc(accuracy)) %>%
    mutate(overall_rank = row_number())

  best_setting <- risk_metrics_df$setting[1]
  best_model <- risk_metrics_df$model[1]
  risk_df <- risk_scores_df %>% filter(setting == best_setting, model == best_model)
  plot_df <- risk_df %>% mutate(fold = factor(fold, levels = unique(fold)))

  list(
    report_label = report_label,
    risk_scores_df = risk_scores_df,
    risk_metrics_df = risk_metrics_df,
    best_setting = best_setting,
    best_model = best_model,
    risk_df = risk_df,
    plot_df = plot_df
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| message: false
```

```{r}
# Fit Platt scaling on pooled LODO scores for the best binary model,
# then show calibration curve (reliability diagram) on the same fold pool.

cal_obj <- calibrate_platt(score_best, score_col = "score_normal",
                           truth_col = "truth", positive = "Normal")

score_best_cal <- score_best %>%
  mutate(score_cal = apply_calibration_platt(cal_obj, score_normal))

# Reliability diagram: bin predicted probs, compare to observed fraction
make_reliability_df <- function(truth, score, positive = "Normal", n_bins = 10) {
  breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  idx    <- findInterval(score, breaks, rightmost.closed = TRUE)
  idx    <- pmin(pmax(idx, 1L), n_bins)
  df     <- data.frame(truth01 = as.integer(as.character(truth) == positive),
                       score   = score, bin = idx)
  df %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_pred = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_obs  = mean(truth01, na.rm = TRUE),
              n         = n(), .groups = "drop")
}

rel_raw <- make_reliability_df(score_best$truth, score_best$score_normal)
rel_cal <- make_reliability_df(score_best_cal$truth, score_best_cal$score_cal)

rel_both <- bind_rows(
  rel_raw %>% mutate(type = "Raw scores"),
  rel_cal %>% mutate(type = "Platt calibrated")
)

ggplot(rel_both, aes(x = mean_pred, y = mean_obs, colour = type)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Mean predicted probability", y = "Observed fraction (P(Normal))",
       colour = NULL, size = "n",
       title = paste0("Reliability diagram: ", best_setting_bin, " / ", best_model_bin)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

cat("Calibrated ROC AUC:", round(auc_roc(score_best_cal$truth == "Normal", score_best_cal$score_cal), 3), "\n")
cat("Calibrated PR  AUC:", round(auc_pr( score_best_cal$truth == "Normal", score_best_cal$score_cal), 3), "\n")
```

## Dev/Hold-out Top-K ensemble (using current pipeline preprocessing)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Build ensemble on top of your current pipeline choices:
# ranking metric priority = ROC AUC -> PR AUC -> Recall.
set.seed(3888)

split_stratified_by_dataset_class <- function(y, dataset, train_prop = 0.75) {
  dev_idx <- c()
  test_idx <- c()
  y_chr <- as.character(y)
  ds_chr <- as.character(dataset)
  for (ds in unique(ds_chr)) {
    for (cl in unique(y_chr)) {
      idx <- which(ds_chr == ds & y_chr == cl)
      if (length(idx) == 0) next
      idx <- sample(idx)
      if (length(idx) == 1) {
        dev_idx <- c(dev_idx, idx)
      } else {
        n_dev <- floor(length(idx) * train_prop)
        n_dev <- max(1, min(n_dev, length(idx) - 1))
        dev_idx <- c(dev_idx, idx[seq_len(n_dev)])
        test_idx <- c(test_idx, idx[(n_dev + 1):length(idx)])
      }
    }
  }
  list(dev_idx = sort(unique(dev_idx)), test_idx = sort(unique(test_idx)))
}

fit_predict_binary_setting_once <- function(X_train_full, y_train, batch_train,
                                            X_test_full, batch_test,
                                            positive = "Normal",
                                            use_weights = TRUE,
                                            apply_batch_correction = TRUE,
                                            weight_scheme = c("ratio", "balanced", "balanced_capped"),
                                            weight_cap = 4,
                                            use_downsampling = TRUE,
                                            downsample_ratio_cap = 3) {
  weight_scheme <- match.arg(weight_scheme)
  setting_label <- if (!isTRUE(use_weights)) {
    "unweighted"
  } else if (weight_scheme == "ratio") {
    "weighted_ratio"
  } else if (weight_scheme == "balanced") {
    "weighted_balanced"
  } else {
    paste0("weighted_balanced_cap", format(weight_cap, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE))
  }

  y_train <- factor(y_train)
  y_test <- factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(X_test_full)), levels = levels(y_train))

  expr_train_raw <- t(X_train_full)
  expr_test_raw <- t(X_test_full)

  # Same downsampling strategy as run_lodo_cv_binary()
  if (isTRUE(use_downsampling)) {
    idx_pos <- which(y_train == positive)
    idx_neg <- which(y_train != positive)
    if (length(idx_pos) > 0 && length(idx_neg) > 0) {
      max_n <- function(n_min) max(1L, as.integer(downsample_ratio_cap * n_min))
      keep_idx <- seq_along(y_train)
      if (length(idx_neg) > max_n(length(idx_pos))) {
        keep_idx <- sort(c(idx_pos, sample(idx_neg, max_n(length(idx_pos)))))
      } else if (length(idx_pos) > max_n(length(idx_neg))) {
        keep_idx <- sort(c(sample(idx_pos, max_n(length(idx_neg))), idx_neg))
      }
      if (length(keep_idx) < length(y_train)) {
        y_train <- droplevels(y_train[keep_idx])
        expr_train_raw <- expr_train_raw[, keep_idx, drop = FALSE]
        batch_train <- batch_train[keep_idx]
      }
    }
  }

  mod_train <- model.matrix(~ y_train)
  cb <- if (isTRUE(apply_batch_correction)) {
    combat_fit_apply(
      expr_train = expr_train_raw,
      batch_train = batch_train,
      mod_train = mod_train,
      expr_test = expr_test_raw,
      batch_test = batch_test
    )
  } else {
    list(train = expr_train_raw, test = expr_test_raw)
  }

  X_train_corr <- t(cb$train)
  X_test_corr <- t(cb$test)

  design_train <- model.matrix(~ y_train)
  fit_lm <- eBayes(lmFit(t(X_train_corr), design_train))
  tt <- topTable(fit_lm, n = 50, sort.by = "P")
  sel_genes <- intersect(rownames(tt), colnames(X_train_corr))
  if (length(sel_genes) < 10) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      sample_id = seq_len(nrow(X_test_full)),
      setting = setting_label,
      model = character(0),
      score_normal = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  X_train <- X_train_corr[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]
  X_test <- X_test_corr[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]

  imp <- impute_fit(X_train)
  X_train_i <- impute_apply(X_train, imp)
  X_test_i <- impute_apply(X_test, imp)

  sc <- standardize_fit(X_train_i)
  X_train_s <- standardize_apply(X_train_i, sc)
  X_test_s <- standardize_apply(X_test_i, sc)

  n_pos <- sum(y_train == positive)
  n_neg <- sum(y_train != positive)
  if (isTRUE(use_weights)) {
    if (weight_scheme == "ratio") {
      pos_w <- if (n_pos > 0) n_neg / n_pos else 1
      neg_w <- 1
    } else {
      n_total <- n_pos + n_neg
      pos_w <- if (n_pos > 0) n_total / (2 * n_pos) else 1
      neg_w <- if (n_neg > 0) n_total / (2 * n_neg) else 1
      if (weight_scheme == "balanced_capped") {
        pos_w <- min(pos_w, weight_cap)
        neg_w <- min(neg_w, weight_cap)
      }
    }
  } else {
    pos_w <- 1
    neg_w <- 1
  }

  neg_label <- setdiff(levels(y_train), positive)[1]
  cw <- c()
  cw[positive] <- pos_w
  cw[neg_label] <- neg_w
  w <- if (use_weights) ifelse(y_train == positive, pos_w, neg_w) else rep(1, length(y_train))

  out <- list()

  pred_knn <- class::knn(train = X_train_s, test = X_test_s, cl = y_train, k = 7, prob = TRUE)
  out[["kNN"]] <- ifelse(pred_knn == positive, attr(pred_knn, "prob"), 1 - attr(pred_knn, "prob"))

  svm_fit <- e1071::svm(
    x = X_train_s, y = y_train, kernel = "radial",
    cost = 1, gamma = 1 / ncol(X_train_s),
    probability = TRUE,
    class.weights = if (use_weights) cw else NULL
  )
  pred_svm <- predict(svm_fit, X_test_s, probability = TRUE)
  prob_svm <- attr(pred_svm, "probabilities")
  out[[if (use_weights) "SVM_RBF_w" else "SVM_RBF"]] <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_svm)) prob_svm[, "Normal"] else prob_svm[, 1]

  rf_fit <- randomForest::randomForest(x = X_train_i, y = y_train, classwt = if (use_weights) cw else NULL)
  prob_rf <- predict(rf_fit, X_test_i, type = "prob")
  out[[if (use_weights) "RF_w" else "RF"]] <- if ("Normal" %in% colnames(prob_rf)) prob_rf[, "Normal"] else prob_rf[, 1]

  glm_fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train = y_train, X_train_s), family = binomial(), weights = w)
  out[[if (use_weights) "Logistic_w" else "Logistic"]] <- as.numeric(predict(glm_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test_s), type = "response"))

  if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
    lasso_fit <- tryCatch(
      glmnet::cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(X_train_s), y = as.numeric(y_train == positive), family = "binomial",
                        alpha = 1, weights = w, standardize = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(lasso_fit)) {
      out[[if (use_weights) "Lasso_w" else "Lasso"]] <- as.numeric(
        predict(lasso_fit, newx = as.matrix(X_test_s), type = "response", s = "lambda.min")
      )
    }
  }

  if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
    enet_fit_once <- tryCatch(
      glmnet::cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(X_train_s), y = as.numeric(y_train == positive),
                        family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5, weights = w, standardize = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(enet_fit_once)) {
      out[[if (use_weights) "ElasticNet_w" else "ElasticNet"]] <- as.numeric(
        predict(enet_fit_once, newx = as.matrix(X_test_s), type = "response", s = "lambda.min")
      )
    }
  }

  if (requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
    xgb_dtrain_once <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
      data  = as.matrix(X_train_s),
      label = as.numeric(y_train == positive),
      weight = w
    )
    xgb_dtest_once <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_test_s))
    xgb_fit_once <- tryCatch(
      xgboost::xgb.train(
        params  = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                       eta = 0.05, max_depth = 4, subsample = 0.8,
                       colsample_bytree = 0.8, min_child_weight = 5, nthread = 1),
        data    = xgb_dtrain_once, nrounds = 150, verbose = 0
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(xgb_fit_once)) {
      out[[if (use_weights) "XGB_w" else "XGB"]] <- as.numeric(predict(xgb_fit_once, xgb_dtest_once))
    }
  }

  score_df <- tibble::as_tibble(out) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = seq_len(nrow(X_test_full))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "model", values_to = "score_normal") %>%
    mutate(setting = setting_label) %>%
    select(sample_id, setting, model, score_normal)

  score_df
}

make_ensemble_weights <- function(selected_df, method = c("rank_roc_pr_recall", "softmax_roc", "roc_x_pr", "equal_weight"), temp = 0.2) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  d <- selected_df %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_roc_auc), desc(mean_pr_auc), desc(mean_recall)) %>%
    mutate(rank_score = rev(seq_len(n())))

  if (method == "rank_roc_pr_recall") {
    d <- d %>% mutate(raw_weight = mean_roc_auc * rank_score + 0.5 * mean_pr_auc + 0.25 * mean_recall)
  } else if (method == "softmax_roc") {
    d <- d %>% mutate(raw_weight = exp(mean_roc_auc / temp))
  } else if (method == "roc_x_pr") {
    d <- d %>% mutate(raw_weight = pmax(mean_roc_auc * mean_pr_auc, 1e-8))
  } else {
    d <- d %>% mutate(raw_weight = 1)
  }

  d %>% mutate(final_weight = raw_weight / sum(raw_weight))
}

ok_all <- !is.na(pMat_big_bin$label_binary) & pMat_big_bin$label_binary != ""

top_k_vec <- c(4, 5, 6, 7)
ensemble_weight_methods <- c("rank_roc_pr_recall", "softmax_roc", "roc_x_pr", "equal_weight")

ens_metrics <- list()
ens_scores <- list()
for (k in top_k_vec) {
  selected <- dev_rank %>% arrange(overall_rank) %>% slice_head(n = k)
  if (nrow(selected) == 0) next
  for (wm in ensemble_weight_methods) {
    wdf <- make_ensemble_weights(selected, method = wm)
    hold_sel <- hold_base_scores %>%
      inner_join(wdf %>% select(setting, model, final_weight), by = c("setting", "model")) %>%
      group_by(sample_id) %>%
      summarise(score_normal = sum(score_normal * final_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(hold_truth, by = "sample_id")

    pred <- ifelse(hold_sel$score_normal >= 0.5, "Normal", "Cancer")
    met <- binary_metrics(hold_sel$truth, pred, positive = "Normal")
    ens_metrics[[length(ens_metrics) + 1]] <- tibble::tibble(
      top_k = k,
      weight_method = wm,
      combo = paste0("top", k, " | ", wm),
      roc_auc = auc_roc(hold_sel$truth == "Normal", hold_sel$score_normal),
      pr_auc = auc_pr(hold_sel$truth == "Normal", hold_sel$score_normal),
      recall = met$recall_normal,
      balanced_accuracy = met$balanced_accuracy
    )
    ens_scores[[length(ens_scores) + 1]] <- hold_sel %>%
      mutate(
        top_k = k,
        weight_method = wm,
        combo = paste0("top", k, " | ", wm)
      )
  }
}

knitr::kable(hold_ens_metrics %>% mutate(across(c(roc_auc, pr_auc, recall, balanced_accuracy), round, 3)),
             caption = "Hold-out ensemble performance (ranked by ROC AUC -> PR AUC -> Recall)")

  transmute(

roc_df_ens <- lapply(roc_thresh_ens, function(t) {
  pred <- score_ens >= t
  tp <- sum(pred & truth01_ens == 1)
  fn <- sum(!pred & truth01_ens == 1)
  fp <- sum(pred & truth01_ens == 0)
  tn <- sum(!pred & truth01_ens == 0)
  tibble(
    threshold = t,
    tpr = if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA_real_ else tp / (tp + fn),
    fpr = if ((fp + tn) == 0) NA_real_ else fp / (fp + tn)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()
```
