## Multiclass pipeline v2 – log2 + ComBat + class weights + probabilities

> **Note on preprocessing**: `build_merged_multiclass_dataset` calls `collapse_to_genes` which applies the same GEO2R-style auto-log2 heuristic used for binary. Within each LODO fold the same `combat_fit_apply` (ComBat → limma fallback) is used. The v2 function below adds **(a)** balanced class weights, **(b)** probability outputs enabling macro OvR ROC AUC, **(c)** multinomial Lasso, and **(d)** a full scorecard, hold-out ensemble, and per-subtype risk calculator mirroring the binary pipeline.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# ── Enhanced multiclass LODO CV ────────────────────────────────────────────
run_lodo_cv_multiclass_v2 <- function(X, y, batch,
                                      use_weights  = TRUE,
                                      n_per_class  = 25) {
  y     <- factor(y)
  batch <- as.character(batch)
  perf       <- data.frame()
  all_preds  <- data.frame()
  all_probs  <- list()

  for (ds in unique(batch)) {
    test_id  <- which(batch == ds)
    train_id <- setdiff(seq_along(batch), test_id)

    y_train <- droplevels(y[train_id])
    y_test  <- factor(as.character(y[test_id]), levels = levels(y_train))
    if (nlevels(y_train) < 2) next

    expr_tr_raw <- t(X[train_id, , drop = FALSE])
    expr_te_raw <- t(X[test_id,  , drop = FALSE])
    mod_train   <- model.matrix(~ y_train)

    cb <- combat_fit_apply(expr_train = expr_tr_raw, batch_train = batch[train_id],
                           mod_train  = mod_train,
                           expr_test  = expr_te_raw, batch_test  = batch[test_id])

    X_tr_full <- t(cb$train)
    X_te_full <- t(cb$test)

    # OvR limma gene selection (fold-internal)
    genes_sel <- select_genes_one_vs_rest(t(X_tr_full), y = y_train,
                                          n_per_class = n_per_class)
    sel_genes <- intersect(genes_sel, colnames(X_tr_full))
    if (length(sel_genes) < 10) next

    X_tr <- X_tr_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]
    X_te <- X_te_full[, sel_genes, drop = FALSE]

    imp <- impute_fit(X_tr); X_tr_i <- impute_apply(X_tr, imp); X_te_i <- impute_apply(X_te, imp)
    sc  <- standardize_fit(X_tr_i); X_tr_s <- standardize_apply(X_tr_i, sc); X_te_s <- standardize_apply(X_te_i, sc)

    lvls <- levels(y_train)
    n_cl <- length(lvls)
    n_te <- nrow(X_te_s)

    # Class weights (balanced)
    tab_tr <- table(y_train)
    n_tot  <- sum(tab_tr)
    cw_mc  <- if (use_weights) {
      setNames(vapply(lvls, function(k) n_tot / (n_cl * max(1, tab_tr[k])), numeric(1)), lvls)
    } else setNames(rep(1, n_cl), lvls)
    sw_mc  <- cw_mc[as.character(y_train)]

    y_te_chr <- as.character(y_test)

    add_result <- function(model_nm, pred_chr, prob_matrix) {
      perf <<- rbind(perf, data.frame(
        fold = ds, model = model_nm,
        accuracy  = mean(pred_chr == y_te_chr, na.rm = TRUE),
        macro_f1  = macro_f1(y_te_chr, pred_chr),
        macro_auc = macro_auc_ovr(y_te_chr, prob_matrix)
      ))
      all_preds <<- rbind(all_preds, data.frame(
        fold = ds, model = model_nm, truth = y_te_chr, pred = pred_chr
      ))
      pdf <- as.data.frame(prob_matrix)
      pdf$fold  <- ds; pdf$model <- model_nm; pdf$truth <- y_te_chr
      all_probs[[length(all_probs) + 1]] <<- pdf
    }

    # kNN – approximate OvR probs from win probability
    pred_knn <- class::knn(X_tr_s, X_te_s, cl = y_train, k = 7, prob = TRUE)
    knn_win  <- attr(pred_knn, "prob")
    pred_chr_knn <- as.character(pred_knn)
    prob_knn <- matrix(0, n_te, n_cl, dimnames = list(NULL, lvls))
    for (i in seq_len(n_te)) {
      prob_knn[i, pred_chr_knn[i]] <- knn_win[i]
      oth <- setdiff(lvls, pred_chr_knn[i])
      if (length(oth)) prob_knn[i, oth] <- (1 - knn_win[i]) / length(oth)
    }
    add_result("kNN", pred_chr_knn, prob_knn)

    # SVM (probability + class weights)
    svm_mc <- tryCatch(
      e1071::svm(X_tr_s, y_train, kernel = "radial", cost = 1,
                 gamma = 1 / ncol(X_tr_s), probability = TRUE,
                 class.weights = if (use_weights) cw_mc else NULL),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(svm_mc)) {
      pred_svm_mc   <- predict(svm_mc, X_te_s, probability = TRUE)
      prob_svm_mc   <- attr(pred_svm_mc, "probabilities")[, lvls, drop = FALSE]
      add_result(if (use_weights) "SVM_RBF_w" else "SVM_RBF",
                 as.character(pred_svm_mc), prob_svm_mc)
    }

    # RF (class weights)
    rf_mc    <- randomForest::randomForest(X_tr_i, y_train,
                                           classwt = if (use_weights) cw_mc else NULL)
    pred_rf_mc  <- predict(rf_mc, X_te_i)
    prob_rf_mc  <- predict(rf_mc, X_te_i, type = "prob")[, lvls, drop = FALSE]
    add_result(if (use_weights) "RF_w" else "RF",
               as.character(pred_rf_mc), prob_rf_mc)

    # Multinomial Lasso (glmnet)
    if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
      lasso_mc <- tryCatch(
        glmnet::cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_tr_s), y_train, family = "multinomial",
                          alpha = 1, weights = sw_mc, standardize = FALSE,
                          type.multinomial = "grouped"),
        error = function(e) { message("Multinom-Lasso fold ", ds, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }
      )
      if (!is.null(lasso_mc)) {
        prob_raw <- predict(lasso_mc, as.matrix(X_te_s), type = "response", s = "lambda.min")[,,1]
        if (is.null(dim(prob_raw))) prob_raw <- t(as.matrix(prob_raw))
        prob_raw <- prob_raw[, intersect(lvls, colnames(prob_raw)), drop = FALSE]
        pred_lasso_mc <- lvls[max.col(prob_raw)]
        add_result(if (use_weights) "LassoMC_w" else "LassoMC",
                   pred_lasso_mc, prob_raw)
      }
    }

    # Multinomial logistic (nnet, sample weights)
    if (requireNamespace("nnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
      mn_mc <- tryCatch(
        nnet::multinom(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train, X_tr_s),
                       weights = sw_mc, trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 100000),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(mn_mc)) {
        prob_mn <- predict(mn_mc, newdata = data.frame(X_te_s), type = "probs")
        if (is.null(dim(prob_mn))) prob_mn <- t(as.matrix(prob_mn))
        prob_mn <- prob_mn[, intersect(lvls, colnames(prob_mn)), drop = FALSE]
        pred_mn_mc <- lvls[max.col(prob_mn)]
        add_result(if (use_weights) "Multinom_w" else "Multinom",
                   pred_mn_mc, prob_mn)
      }
    }
  }

  list(perf = perf, preds = all_preds, probs = bind_rows(all_probs))
}

res_mc_v2 <- run_lodo_cv_multiclass_v2(X_mc, y_mc, batch_mc,
                                        use_weights = TRUE, n_per_class = 25)
cat("Multiclass v2 folds completed. Models:\n")
print(unique(res_mc_v2$perf$model))
```

  summarise(
    mean_accuracy  = mean(accuracy,  na.rm = TRUE),

    macro_auc    = sprintf("%.3f \u00B1 %.3f", mean_macro_auc, sd_macro_auc)
  ) %>%

## Multiclass v2 – hold-out ensemble

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
set.seed(3888)

# Stratified dev/hold-out split (reuse helper from binary)
split_mc <- split_stratified_by_dataset_class(y_mc, batch_mc, train_prop = 0.75)
dev_mc_idx  <- split_mc$dev_idx
hold_mc_idx <- split_mc$test_idx

X_mc_dev  <- X_mc[dev_mc_idx,  , drop = FALSE]; y_mc_dev  <- y_mc[dev_mc_idx];  batch_mc_dev  <- batch_mc[dev_mc_idx]
X_mc_hold <- X_mc[hold_mc_idx, , drop = FALSE]; y_mc_hold <- y_mc[hold_mc_idx]; batch_mc_hold <- batch_mc[hold_mc_idx]

cat("MC dev size:", nrow(X_mc_dev), "  hold size:", nrow(X_mc_hold), "\n")

# LODO on dev set to rank models
res_mc_dev <- run_lodo_cv_multiclass_v2(X_mc_dev, y_mc_dev, batch_mc_dev,
                                         use_weights = TRUE, n_per_class = 25)

mc_dev_rank <- res_mc_dev$perf %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(mean_mac_auc = mean(macro_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_mac_f1  = mean(macro_f1,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_mac_auc), desc(mean_mac_f1)) %>%
  mutate(dev_rank = row_number())

knitr::kable(mc_dev_rank %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)),
             caption = "Multiclass dev-set ranking (macro OvR AUC)")

# ── Fit each model on full dev set, predict hold-out ─────────────────────
fit_predict_mc_once <- function(X_tr, y_tr, batch_tr, X_te, batch_te,
                                use_weights = TRUE, n_per_class = 25) {
  y_tr <- factor(y_tr); lvls <- levels(y_tr); n_cl <- length(lvls)
  expr_tr_raw <- t(X_tr); expr_te_raw <- t(X_te)
  mod_tr <- model.matrix(~ y_tr)
  cb <- combat_fit_apply(expr_tr_raw, batch_tr, mod_tr, expr_te_raw, batch_te)
  X_tr_c <- t(cb$train); X_te_c <- t(cb$test)

  genes_sel <- select_genes_one_vs_rest(t(X_tr_c), y = y_tr, n_per_class = n_per_class)
  sel_g <- intersect(genes_sel, colnames(X_tr_c))
  if (length(sel_g) < 10) return(NULL)

  X_tr2 <- X_tr_c[, sel_g]; X_te2 <- X_te_c[, sel_g]
  imp <- impute_fit(X_tr2)
  X_tr_i <- impute_apply(X_tr2, imp); X_te_i <- impute_apply(X_te2, imp)
  sc <- standardize_fit(X_tr_i)
  X_tr_s <- standardize_apply(X_tr_i, sc); X_te_s <- standardize_apply(X_te_i, sc)

  tab_tr <- table(y_tr); n_tot <- sum(tab_tr)
  cw_mc <- if (use_weights) setNames(vapply(lvls, function(k) n_tot / (n_cl * max(1,tab_tr[k])), numeric(1)), lvls) else setNames(rep(1,n_cl),lvls)
  sw_mc <- cw_mc[as.character(y_tr)]
  n_te  <- nrow(X_te_s)

  out <- list()

  # kNN
  pk <- class::knn(X_tr_s, X_te_s, y_tr, k=7, prob=TRUE)
  kw <- attr(pk,"prob"); pkc <- as.character(pk)
  pm_knn <- matrix(0,n_te,n_cl,dimnames=list(NULL,lvls))
  for(i in seq_len(n_te)){ pm_knn[i,pkc[i]] <- kw[i]; oth <- setdiff(lvls,pkc[i]); if(length(oth)) pm_knn[i,oth]<-(1-kw[i])/length(oth) }
  out[["kNN"]] <- pm_knn

  # RF
  rf2 <- randomForest::randomForest(X_tr_i, y_tr, classwt=if(use_weights)cw_mc else NULL)
  out[[if(use_weights)"RF_w"else"RF"]] <- predict(rf2, X_te_i, type="prob")[,lvls,drop=FALSE]

  # Multinomial Lasso
  if(requireNamespace("glmnet",quietly=TRUE)){
    lf <- tryCatch(glmnet::cv.glmnet(as.matrix(X_tr_s),y_tr,family="multinomial",alpha=1,weights=sw_mc,standardize=FALSE,type.multinomial="grouped"),error=function(e)NULL)
    if(!is.null(lf)){
      pr <- predict(lf,as.matrix(X_te_s),type="response",s="lambda.min")[,,1]
      if(is.null(dim(pr))) pr <- t(as.matrix(pr))
      out[[if(use_weights)"LassoMC_w"else"LassoMC"]] <- pr[,intersect(lvls,colnames(pr)),drop=FALSE]
    }
  }

  # Multinom
  if(requireNamespace("nnet",quietly=TRUE)){
    mn2 <- tryCatch(nnet::multinom(y_tr~.,data=data.frame(y_tr,X_tr_s),weights=sw_mc,trace=FALSE,MaxNWts=100000),error=function(e)NULL)
    if(!is.null(mn2)){
      pm_mn <- predict(mn2,newdata=data.frame(X_te_s),type="probs")
      if(is.null(dim(pm_mn))) pm_mn <- t(as.matrix(pm_mn))
      out[[if(use_weights)"Multinom_w"else"Multinom"]] <- pm_mn[,intersect(lvls,colnames(pm_mn)),drop=FALSE]
    }
  }

  out
}

hold_mc_probs_list <- fit_predict_mc_once(
  X_mc_dev, y_mc_dev, batch_mc_dev,
  X_mc_hold, batch_mc_hold,
  use_weights = TRUE, n_per_class = 25
)

if (!is.null(hold_mc_probs_list)) {
  lvls_hold <- levels(factor(y_mc_dev))

  # Single-model hold-out metrics
  hold_mc_single <- bind_rows(lapply(names(hold_mc_probs_list), function(nm) {
    pm  <- hold_mc_probs_list[[nm]]
    lvls_pm <- intersect(lvls_hold, colnames(pm))
    pred_chr <- lvls_pm[max.col(pm[, lvls_pm, drop=FALSE])]
    tibble::tibble(
      model     = nm,
      accuracy  = mean(pred_chr == as.character(y_mc_hold), na.rm = TRUE),
      macro_f1  = macro_f1(as.character(y_mc_hold), pred_chr),
      macro_auc = macro_auc_ovr(as.character(y_mc_hold), pm[, lvls_pm, drop=FALSE])
    )
  })) %>% arrange(desc(macro_auc), desc(macro_f1)) %>% mutate(hold_rank = row_number())

  knitr::kable(hold_mc_single %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)),
               caption = "Multiclass hold-out: single-model performance (macro OvR AUC ranked)")

  # Ensemble: top-k equal-weight probability averaging
  top_k_mc_vec <- c(2, 3, 4)
  ens_mc_metrics <- list()
  for (k in top_k_mc_vec) {
    sel_models <- mc_dev_rank %>% slice_head(n = k) %>% pull(model)
    sel_models <- intersect(sel_models, names(hold_mc_probs_list))
    if (length(sel_models) < 2) next

    avg_pm <- Reduce("+", lapply(sel_models, function(nm) {
      pm <- hold_mc_probs_list[[nm]]
      pm[, intersect(lvls_hold, colnames(pm)), drop = FALSE]
    })) / length(sel_models)

    pred_ens_chr <- colnames(avg_pm)[max.col(avg_pm)]
    ens_mc_metrics[[as.character(k)]] <- tibble::tibble(
      top_k     = k,
      models    = paste(sel_models, collapse = " + "),
      accuracy  = mean(pred_ens_chr == as.character(y_mc_hold), na.rm = TRUE),
      macro_f1  = macro_f1(as.character(y_mc_hold), pred_ens_chr),
      macro_auc = macro_auc_ovr(as.character(y_mc_hold), avg_pm)
    )
  }

  hold_mc_ens <- bind_rows(ens_mc_metrics) %>% arrange(desc(macro_auc))
  knitr::kable(hold_mc_ens %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)),
               caption = "Multiclass hold-out: ensemble performance (equal-weight prob averaging)")

  # Best ensemble confusion matrix
  best_k_mc <- hold_mc_ens$top_k[1]
  best_sel_mc <- mc_dev_rank %>% slice_head(n = best_k_mc) %>% pull(model)
  best_sel_mc <- intersect(best_sel_mc, names(hold_mc_probs_list))
  best_avg_pm <- Reduce("+", lapply(best_sel_mc, function(nm) {
    pm <- hold_mc_probs_list[[nm]]
    pm[, intersect(lvls_hold, colnames(pm)), drop = FALSE]
  })) / length(best_sel_mc)
  best_pred_ens_mc <- colnames(best_avg_pm)[max.col(best_avg_pm)]

  tab_mc_ens <- as.data.frame(table(truth = as.character(y_mc_hold), pred = best_pred_ens_mc))
  ggplot(tab_mc_ens, aes(x = pred, y = truth, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 4) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#41AB5D") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Predicted", y = "True",
         title = paste0("Multiclass ensemble confusion matrix (top-", best_k_mc, " avg)")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("Hold-out prediction skipped (insufficient data in hold set).\n")
}
```

## Multiclass risk calculator (subtype probabilities)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Output: per-sample probability of each PAM50 subtype from the best LODO model.

if (!is.null(hold_mc_probs_list) && best_model_mc_v2 %in% names(hold_mc_probs_list)) {
  lvls_rc <- colnames(hold_mc_probs_list[[best_model_mc_v2]])
  mc_risk_df <- as.data.frame(hold_mc_probs_list[[best_model_mc_v2]])
  colnames(mc_risk_df) <- lvls_rc
  mc_risk_df$predicted_subtype <- lvls_rc[max.col(mc_risk_df[, lvls_rc])]
  mc_risk_df$confidence        <- apply(mc_risk_df[, lvls_rc], 1, max)
  mc_risk_df$true_subtype      <- as.character(y_mc_hold)
  mc_risk_df$correct           <- mc_risk_df$predicted_subtype == mc_risk_df$true_subtype

  cat("Multiclass risk calculator: hold-out subtype probability table (top 20 rows)\n")
  knitr::kable(head(mc_risk_df %>%
                      arrange(desc(confidence)) %>%
                      mutate(across(all_of(lvls_rc), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                             confidence = round(confidence, 3)), 20),
               caption = paste0("Per-sample PAM50 subtype probabilities (", best_model_mc_v2, ")"))

  # Stacked bar: predicted probability profile per true subtype
  mc_risk_long <- mc_risk_df %>%
    mutate(sample_idx = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(lvls_rc), names_to = "subtype", values_to = "probability") %>%
    mutate(true_subtype = factor(true_subtype))

  ggplot(mc_risk_long, aes(x = sample_idx, y = probability, fill = subtype)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ true_subtype, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Sample", y = "P(subtype)", fill = "Predicted",
         title = paste0("PAM50 subtype probability profiles (", best_model_mc_v2, ")")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

  # OvR calibration per subtype
  mc_cal_df <- bind_rows(lapply(lvls_rc, function(k) {
    tibble::tibble(
      subtype  = k,
      roc_auc  = auc_roc(as.integer(mc_risk_df$true_subtype == k), mc_risk_df[[k]]),
      pr_auc   = auc_pr( as.integer(mc_risk_df$true_subtype == k), mc_risk_df[[k]])
    )
  }))
  knitr::kable(mc_cal_df %>% mutate(across(c(roc_auc, pr_auc), round, 3)),
               caption = "Per-subtype OvR AUC on hold-out (multiclass risk model)")

} else {
  cat("Multiclass risk calculator skipped: best model probabilities not available.\n")
}
```
